title: Hymn (locale)
description: A hymn in one language (data/i18n/<locale>/hymns/<id>.json). The full text is allowed only with an open license, in the public domain or with permission; otherwise keep the incipit and a reference.

incipit.description: First words of the hymn, used to name it.

podoben_incipit.description: Incipit of the model melody in this language (e.g. 'Podobie: Cel ce Te-ai înălțat …'), when there is no hymn record for it.
